metadados.title: Insulin Calculation - Nursing
metadados.description: Perform the insulin calculation using the rule of three quickly and safely. This calculator provides detailed explanations and rounding, ideal for nursing and ensuring patient safety in medication administration.

lead: Quick and safe aspiration calculator for International Units (IU).

secoes.corpo:
Examples on the 1 mL (100 IU) syringe:

100 IU equals 1.0 mL

50 IU equals 0.5 mL

30 IU equals 0.3 mL

10 IU equals 0.1 mL

Safety Tip: 
Prefer using insulin syringes (already graduated in IU) to minimize the risk of errors.

Volume for Aspiration

textoCompleto:
Insulin Calculation

CALCULATOR

Quick and safe aspiration calculator for International Units (IU).

Insulin Calculator

Basic Measurements and Proportions
Examples on the 1 mL (100 IU) syringe:

100 IU equals 1.0 mL

50 IU equals 0.5 mL

30 IU equals 0.3 mL

10 IU equals 0.1 mL

Safety Tip: 
Prefer using insulin syringes (already graduated in IU) to minimize the risk of errors.
